## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): multi-component FS on both carrier signs

Raw R(B) first (left/middle panels), then per-tone onset tracks and FFTs vs the step-2 model expectations (`data/6`, `data/7`; both complete, sr1 50 µV, I ≈ 9.9 nA, T ≈ 1.2–1.3 K). **Electron (run 6, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** a light tone at **7.1 T** running to the record's low edge (onset ≤ 0.30 T, censored; harmonics 2×/3×/4× tracked; SNR 41) plus heavy spectral weight at **22.2 / 29.5 T** (SNR 101/88) — centered at ~25.9 T ≈ the ABAB heavy-pocket expectation (25.6 T, m* 0.061), split by ~7.3 ≈ F_light (magnetic-breakdown / intersubband sidebands of one heavy pocket, or a genuinely split heavy pocket). Two-pocket closure: 7.1 + 25.9 ≈ 33.0 ≈ F_L — Luttinger closes under a light+heavy assignment, and the ABAB prediction (7.5 + 25.6) lands within ~0.4 T of both. A **single-band ABCA read (one 33 T fundamental) is inconsistent with run 6** — the dominant low-onset tone sits at 7.1 T with strong harmonics. **Hole (run 7, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** tones at 4.7, **6.6** (dominant, onset 0.71 T), 8.5, 12.3 T. Candidate ABAB pair 4.7 + 6.6 = 11.3 T (91 % of F_L; predicted 5.3 + 7.1); 8.5 T matches the region-B mosaic full density (gate n = −1.2 puts region B at −0.77×10¹² → F_L,B ≈ 8.0 T; run-5 read), 12.3 T ≈ F_L,A (breakdown orbit, or a real large pocket). Single-point FFTs cannot separate harmonics / combination orbits / mosaic tones from real pockets — **the F(n) branches of a Landau fan settle the assignment** (plan step 4): real pockets disperse linearly with n and sum to F_L(n); harmonics scale as integer multiples of one branch; region-B tones ride a branch offset by +0.43×10¹².

"""sdh-spot-check read: runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12, B 0->10 T) + 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12, 10->0.3 T), D=0.
Raw R(B) first, then per-tone onset tracks (sdh_onset) and FFT in 1/B against the model expectations."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

SPOTS = {6: ('electron', +3.2), 7: ('hole', -1.2)}
MODEL = {6: {'ABAB pair': (7.5, 25.6), 'ABCA': (33.1,)},   # step-2 model table, m* (0.028/0.061) / 0.074
         7: {'ABAB pair': (5.3, 7.1), 'ABCA': (12.4,)}}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 8))
for row, (rid, (side, n12)) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    I = r.col('sr0_X') / -1e6
    R = np.abs(r.col('sr1_X') / I)
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    so = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I)))
    print(f"=== run {rid} ({side}, n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {F_L:.1f} T) ===")
    print(so.summary())
    print()
    a = ax[row, 0]; a.plot(B, R, lw=0.5, color='k')
    a.set_xlabel('B (T)'); a.set_ylabel('|Rxx| (Ohm)')
    a.set_title(f"run {rid} — {side} n = {n12:+.1f}e12 (raw)")
    m = B >= 1.2
    a = ax[row, 1]; a.plot(1 / B[m], R[m], lw=0.5, color='k')
    a.set_xlabel('1/B (1/T)'); a.set_title('vs 1/B (B > 1.2 T)')
    a = ax[row, 2]
    for blo, c in ((1.5, 'C0'), (2.5, 'C1')):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(blo, 10.0), nfft=4096, log=False)
        a.plot(f, sp[0] / sp[0].max(), lw=0.8, color=c, label=f'FFT window B > {blo} T')
    for t in so.tones:
        if not (t.marginal or t.near_residual):
            a.axvline(t.freq, color='0.6', lw=0.6, zorder=0)
    for lbl, (fs, c) in zip(MODEL[rid], [(MODEL[rid]['ABAB pair'], 'g'), (MODEL[rid]['ABCA'], 'r')]):
        for fm in fs:
            a.axvline(fm, color=c, ls='--', lw=1)
        a.plot([], [], color=c, ls='--', label=f'{lbl}: {"/".join(f"{x:.1f}" for x in fs)} T')
    a.axvline(F_L, color='r', ls=':', lw=1)
    a.set_xlim(0, 45); a.set_xlabel('F (T)'); a.set_ylabel('FFT (norm.)')
    a.legend(fontsize=7); a.set_title('FFT in 1/B — tones (grey) vs model (dashed)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.24..+3.24e12 (181 pts co-swept TG/BG, run-5 cal), B 0.35-10.00 T 50 mT (194 rows), sr1 100 uV, ends at 10 T · **ETA ~18:58** (≈13h30m)

Plan step 4, operator-requested; follows the ana read of runs 6/7 (multi-tone SdH on both signs, harmonic/combination/mosaic ambiguity a single density cannot break). The fan traces **F(n) branches and filling-factor lines**: real pockets disperse with n and sum to F_L(n) = |n|h/4e; harmonics ride at integer multiples of one branch; region-B mosaic tones ride a branch offset by +0.43×10¹² (run 5). ABAB → two branches (light + heavy) closing to F_L on both signs; ABCA → one full-density branch; ABCB → gapped CNP at D = 0 with strong e–h branch asymmetry. **Fast axis:** co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) along the calibrated D = 0 line (run-5 cal), n = −1.24 → +3.24×10¹² in 181 pts (dn = 0.025 → ≥2 pts per filling gap above 2 T, ~10 at 10 T). **Slow axis:** B = 0.35 → 10.00 T in 50 mT (194 rows, ascending from 0) — 1/B-Nyquist-valid for F ≤ 35 T above ~1.9 T (heavy-tone onsets are ≥1.3 T); runs 6/7 stay the fine-1/B anchors at two densities. **Coverage trade:** the hole side ends at n = −1.27×10¹² (TG −0.3 V floor) — the deeper hole regime is outside the committed box (extending it is session-banned), so the hole-side read leans on the low-|n| branch structure plus run 7. Sensitivity 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS (run-5 ridge sizing): the ν = 0 CNP stripe will clip at high B — accepted, the stacking evidence lives off-ridge and the clip is flagged in analysis. Leak trip 1 nA (auto-interrupt). **Price** (calibrated: 1.098 s/pt measured on run 5 at fast_delay 1.0 with this fp set; ramp rates from runs 6/7): 194 rows × ~227 s ≈ 12.3 h nominal → headline **~13.5 h** (session evidence: actuals run 5–10 % over). Ends at **10 T** with gates at the electron end — follow-ups (LK masses, D ≠ 0) ride the field down, never re-traversing. **Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed): first 2 rows ~8 min (rail/leak/levels); ~2 T (~2.2 h, partial fan re-form — low-F fan lines visible); ~5 T (~6 h, FFT-vs-n branch check); ~8 T. Abort criteria: leak trip, off-ridge railing, or no fan structure by 4 T (contradicts runs 6/7 → configuration problem, stop and re-establish state).

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`, plan step 4): n fast (co-swept gate line), B slow 0.35 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.24, 3.24, 181)                    # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.025e12
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.35, 10.0001, 0.05), 4)      # 194 rows, ascending from where the magnet sits
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"fast line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 x{len(n_vec)} -> Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}], "
      f"Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}]; slow B {B_vec[0]} .. {B_vec[-1]} T x{len(B_vec)} (50 mT)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.35 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at ~10 nA (run-5 ridge sizing). The nu=0 CNP stripe will clip at high B - accepted, see md.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0 (run-5 cal): fast co-swept (Vtg,Vbg), n -1.24..+3.24e12 x181; "
                  "slow B 0.35..10.00 T x194 (50 mT); fast_delay 1.0, slow_delay 3.0; sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan, region-A cal (run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089e12, D_offset -0.013 V/nm): '
              f'fast co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) along D = 0, n = -1.24 .. +3.24e12 in 181 pts (dn 0.025e12); '
              f'slow B = 0.35 .. 10.00 T in 50 mT steps (194 rows); fast_delay 1.0 s, slow_delay 3.0 s; sr1 100 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=3.0, fast_delay=1.0)
# ends at 10 T, gates at the n = +3.24e12 end of the line - follow-ups ride the field down; no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
